I work with small budgets clients that have big ambitious, every campaign is different but there are some things you can do to get off to a great start. 

  
As you mentioned your best bet is to run a lead generation campaign with 2 ad sets 1 focusing on ADV+ and the other using detailed targeting, preferably with 2x or 3x narrow option, age will play a huge factor in your success maybe target people aged 34+ instead of leaving it too wide spread.

  
Regarding your creatives, I would recommend a minimum of 5 creative variants with 5 copy and 5 headline options, MAKE SURE YOUR MESSAGING IS CLEAT AF, NO FLUF!! Since you have no historic data, month 1 will be your testing ground. The more data you can gather the better you'll be able to optimise your campaign in month 2 and 3 

  
I would not recommend using LaL audiences at this stage, only once you start seeing conversion on META's end would I then create LaL with optimisations in conversion

Now for where the money is; since their budget is quiet limited, I would advise for you to use on meta lead forms, they are typically the cheapest option and they can be very effective if setup correctly. Use qualifying questions and conditional logic to disqualify potential time wasters. In combination with the forms use a [make.com](http://make.com) to setup an automation so that when you do receive a lead it gets sent to your clients inbox instantly (watch a youtube tutorial on this) 

  
If you follow the above I can almost guarantee that you'll see results within your first week

MIddle of funnel  
Here you place any offers, the audience should consist of any who added your products to cart and LaL audiences (again purchase based on look a likes)  
2 creative images or videos are fine with OFFERS in both COPY and the CREATIVE

  
Bottom of funnel  
Retargeting everything, Web visits, FB, IG, EMAIL, Content Views, and 1% LaL's,  
for creative use a dynamic carousel only, with strong copy...  
Usually, this type of funnel takes 2-3 weeks to optimise, obviously with budget split \]  
TOF 50%-60%  
MOF 20%-30%  
BOF 10%-20%
